methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The EEXI determines the standard CO2 emissions based on the installed engine power, transport capacity (DWT) and voyage speed (Vref).

paper_type.evidence_quote: The results of these calculations are compared with energy efficiency operational data coming from (i) outsource open access databases (over 9,000 vessels) plus (ii) analysis results from other relevant studies performed on approx. 30,000 ships [3, 9-10].

regulatory_driver.evidence_quote: A comparative analysis is made between required (theoretical) values of the examined KPIs (according to the guidelines provided by MARPOL Annex VI amendments) and the attained values coming from secondary data available from open source data repositories, such as the IMO Data Collection System (IMO DCS) and the EU’s Monitoring, Reporting, Verification (MRV) database.
